notes.title: Update 2.1 - New Character
notes.content:
Hello,

We are here again, giving you more content as always. This time we are happy to let all you know that there is a new playable character with his own abilitiy. 

What this means is that now you will have more fun since there is more ways to fight with enemies, to use the [b]new character[/b] you only need to press [b]"C"[/b] or [b]"Up D-Pad"[/b] (in gamepad).

So here are the news of the [b]Update 2.1[/b]:
[list]
    [*]Bug fixed, now you are able to pick up the arrows you find on the floor.
    [*]Add a new playable character.
    [*]Update: some sprites has been updated for your confort.
[/list]
Please feel free to comment any bug/glitch you find or any suggest/report.

Thanks for support [b]Tarim[/b]! ːtappleː

notes.title: Not longer Early Access + GlossDo Pack released
notes.content:
Hello!

We are happy to let know everyone that Tarim is not longer Early Access, what does this mean? Tarim is now working as a full released game, with no bugs and enough content. 

However, we are not saying that it is all, we are looking to release new content this week like achievements, as well as 2 new playable characters with unique special attacks for each one.

The updates for the release version are:

- Fixed some bugs that resulted on a unplayable game.

- Added a [b]save button[/b], while you are playing as well as a save button in pause mode.
- Added [b]Gamepad Support[/b]
- Added more [b]story content[/b], like [b]dialogues[/b] that makes Tarim story be more enjoyable.

- Update: Tarim is now [b]a little less difficult[/b], since we was noticed that the game was very dificult for some people.

Now you are able to buy the [b]"GlossDo Pack"[/b] that includes: Blaite + Robo Do It + Tarim with a nice discount.

Hope you are happy with the news and don't forget to share your review of Tarim! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update Alpha 1.1.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

New update is here, and as we are on 1.1.9, we are ready for Alpha 1.2, which mean that a lot of new content is coming!

- Added: If you already have a saved game, game will ask you if you want to overwrite the data, this way you will not lose your data for a miss click.

- Fix bug that don't let you come back from the store.
- Fix issue with a level in second chapter where you was not able to complete the level.
- Fix bug that make you run like flash and then be able to go out of the world.
- Fix bug that was duplicating enemies, that was causing performance issues and dificult gameplay.

- Some more minor bugs fixed and content added.

Enjoy this update!

Thanks for the suppor and don't forget to report any suggest or issue in the Steam Forums or here!

notes.title: Hotfix - Update Alpha 1.1.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Right now we are almost sending a new update with full support for gamepad and including some more updates like more supported languages and achievements, but we had to do a hotfix update.

- Fix issues with some destructible objects that prevent to see them or destroy it.
- Fix issue with OSX that crash the game when you tried to start it.
- Fix issues with some levels that prevented you from completing the level.

- Add new background music that make the game feels much better.
- Add Steam Overlay

However, for the OSX issue and add Steam Overlay (to prepare the game for getting achievements) our only option was to use a new save folder, so if you already played the game you will not be able to continue your old game, you will need to start a new game.

If you are looking to recover your data, please leave a message and we will help you to get it done.

Thanks for the support! ːbatblackː
